g.text: 1. USER specialization: all four roles live in one users table, split by the user_role column. The API lets only STUDENT and FACULTY place orders; STAFF and ADMIN run the kitchen.
2. CONTAINS is the order_items table, with composite key (order_id, item_id). item_price_at_order freezes the price when the order is placed.

3. KITCHEN_QUEUE_ENTRY is the kitchen_queue table, keyed by order_id. A trigger adds the entry when an order is placed and removes it at READY_FOR_PICKUP or CANCELLED, so ORDER participation is partial.
4. pickup_code is unique only among active orders (partial unique index), so it is not marked as a key. The receipt QR encodes this value.
5. KITCHEN_CONFIG is a single-row settings table with no foreign keys. The kitchen_board view reads parallel_stations to estimate ready times.
